idea-plugin.name: .NET Test Data
idea-plugin.description:
.NET Test Data — valid fixtures for C# xUnit, offline

Generate an idiomatic C# xUnit [Theory] whose [InlineData] rows are spec-valid values — and their invalid variants — straight from the Kassi engine. Unlike a hand-rolled Bogus faker, every "valid" row passes the real checksum (IBAN mod-97, card Luhn, national-ID schemes), and every "invalid" row is wrong on purpose, so your validator is tested against both. 100% offline and deterministic.

  • IBAN (ISO 13616 mod-97), card PAN (Luhn, test BINs) and national ID (NL/DE/AU/GB/CY) kinds — each a ready [Theory] with valid + invalid rows.
  • Pick a kind, Generate, Copy into your test project. Loads in Rider and every IntelliJ-based IDE.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ C# Test Data.
